description: Mille Fleurs is one of seven magnificent mansions located around the Queen's Park Savannah in Port of Spain, featuring a balanced and symmetrical architectural style best described as French Provincial. This charming mansion was built in 1904 under the direction of renown architect George Brown of the Trinidad Trading Company and as a gift to Dr Enrique Prada, who would serve as the Mayor of Port of Spain from 1914 to 1917.
